item.title: AI Security Spending Jumps as Fear Outpaces Proof of Value
item.description: CISOs are not waiting for AI to prove its cybersecurity value before investing in the technology. Is it the right move?
item.dc:creator: Jai Vijayan

item.title: Fighting Your Dragons Through Tough Tech Times
item.description: Cybersecurity industry veteran Hal Pomeranz gives a pep talk on career anxiety and self-doubt and shares how to build meaningful connections during historical tech industry downturns.
item.dc:creator: Dark Reading Editorial Team

item.title: BragJack Attack Can Turn a Browser's Agentic AI Against It
item.description: A new type of attack hijacks the AI assistant built directly into various browsers to access sensitive information, execute malicious actions, and exfiltrate data.
item.dc:creator: Elizabeth Montalbano

item.title: Cyber Op Targets South Korean Media & Automotive Sectors
item.description: A likely North Korean advanced persistent threat (APT) group used a previously undocumented Linux espionage toolkit to compromise load balancers, gain access to communications, and further exploit networks.
item.dc:creator: Robert Lemos

item.title: Microsoft Issues Emergency Fixes After Massive Patch Tuesday
item.description: You can't make an omelet without breaking a few eggs, and you can't patch nearly 1,000 CVEs without a few glitches.
item.dc:creator: Rob Wright

item.title: Black Hat USA 2026 | OpenAI's Deep Dive Into Hugging Face Incident
item.description: At Black Hat USA, OpenAI engineers reconstruct the Hugging Face incident and explore lessons learned about AI safeguards and cyber resilience.
item.dc:creator: Black Hat Staff

item.title: VectraRAT Can Hack Windows Enterprises for $250 per Month
item.description: The full-service malware-as-a-service (MaaS) platform offers a Windows implant, command-and-control (C2) infrastructure, and an operator panel for comprehensive remote access.
item.dc:creator: Elizabeth Montalbano

item.title: 'Sandworm' Chains Cisco Vulnerabilities to Deploy Cyclops Blink
item.description: The notorious Russian threat group is spreading an upgraded version of the botnet malware, which the FBI disrupted in 2022.
item.dc:creator: Jai Vijayan

item.title: Maximum Severity GitLab Flaw Puts Supply Chains at Risk
item.description: CVE-2026-85706 is a path traversal vulnerability with a 10 out of 10 CVSS score, affecting both GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition instances.
item.dc:creator: Rob Wright

item.title: Anthropic CEO: Time to Shift From Improving to Controlling AI
item.description: Dario Amodei says it's time to slow the pace of frontier AI improvements so that security and risk prevention efforts can catch up. What does this mean for enterprises?
item.dc:creator: Elizabeth Montalbano

item.title: Threat Actor Generates 1M Personalized Fraud Emails in 3 Days
item.description: Cybercriminals behind malicious email campaigns no longer have to compromise volume for credibility, or vice versa, thanks to AI.
item.dc:creator: Nate Nelson

item.title: CISA Calls for More Guidance, Less Spin, as Cyber Outages Escalate
item.description: A new joint government advisory signals a regulatory shift, pressing organizations to adopt more transparent breach notification and incident response protocols.
item.dc:creator: Arielle Waldman

item.title: SpiderSilk Hunts External Threats With AI-Based Scanner
item.description: The Dubai-based threat detection startup uses artificial intelligence tools to scan billions of IP addresses to find exposed assets, leaked data, and zero-day vulnerabilities.
item.dc:creator: Agam Shah

item.title: Why AI Is So Good at Scamming Humans
item.description: Fred Heiding of Menlo Park Intelligence talks with the Dark Reading News Desk about his research on frontier models, and their ability to influence human behavior and create emotional dependency.

item.title: AI Governance Can't Wait
item.description: Adversaries can manipulate AI's defensive reasoning to silently compromise target networks.
item.dc:creator: Tony Anscombe

item.title: Papercut AI Swarm Attack Heralds Changes for Cyber Kill Chain
item.description: From creating lab environments for staging and testing agentic attacks to reconnaissance to lateral movement and exfiltration, the most innovative attackers are widely incorporating AI.
item.dc:creator: Robert Lemos

item.title: Indonesia Hit by Android Banking App-Cloning Campaign
item.description: The GoldFactory threat group exploits the Android Work Profile feature to deliver the Gigabud Trojan, while Mantax Otax spreads separately.
item.dc:creator: Alexander Culafi

item.title: Voice Callers Exploit BYOD to Reach Microsoft 365, Corporate Data
item.description: Threat actors are leveraging Microsoft's Graph API to identify lucrative targets, then passing their access to extortion groups like ShinyHunters.
item.dc:creator: Nate Nelson

item.title: Nightmare-Eclipse Strikes Again With 'ShieldCrash' Windows Exploit
item.description: The disgruntled researcher continued their vendetta against Microsoft by publishing yet another zero-day exploit for Windows Defender.
item.dc:creator: Elizabeth Montalbano

item.title: EU Cyber Resilience Act to Enforce New Reporting Requirements
item.description: Starting Friday, European organizations will have just 24 hours to notify the EU government any time they discover serious product security incidents.
item.dc:creator: Nate Nelson

item.title: Mythos Vulnerability Firehose Hits a Human Bottleneck
item.description: An analysis of Project Glasswing findings shows only a fraction of the bugs it has discovered have reached disclosure, and an even smaller number have been fixed.
item.dc:creator: Jai Vijayan

item.title: US Government Accuses Chinese AI Firms of Distilling Frontier Models
item.description: US agencies claim Chinese companies covertly extracted billions of tokens from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, and SpaceX's Grok to reduce development costs.
item.dc:creator: Alexander Culafi

item.title: Identity-Based AI Attack Threatens Security of Enterprise Data
item.description: "Workflow identity hijacking" can bypass standard security controls and hijack an organization's data by sending a basic request through an unauthenticated entry point.
item.dc:creator: Elizabeth Montalbano

item.title: Patch Tuesday Sets Another Record With 974 CVEs
item.description: Attackers are actively exploiting two of the vulnerabilities, and another 58 are more likely to be exploited, according to Microsoft.
item.dc:creator: Jai Vijayan

item.title: Attackers Use Multi-Hop Google Redirects for Phishing Campaign
item.description: Threat actors are abusing multiple Google services to evade detection, ultimately harvesting credentials or installing ScreenConnect remote access.
item.dc:creator: Alexander Culafi

item.title: OpenAI Agents Took Over Wiki Site Before Hugging Face Attack
item.description: Researchers and OpenAI disagree on whether an earlier incident involving DseWiki, which the company did not disclose, was a “hack."
item.dc:creator: Nate Nelson

item.title: ClickFix Campaigns Abuse Legitimate Services for Persistent Access
item.description: Two separate attacks demonstrate how threat actors are finding new ways to compromise organizations by using the popular social engineering tactic.
item.dc:creator: Elizabeth Montalbano

item.title: Cybercriminals Hack Brazilian Government Servers to Host Phishing Sites
item.description: A Chinese-language group is compromising government and education sites to create a reverse-proxy network with gambling-themed sites.
item.dc:creator: Robert Lemos

item.title: Companies Have 6 Months to Prepare for Automated Attacks
item.description: Frontier AI models have already demonstrated they can autonomously — and in some cases, inadvertently — conduct end-to-end compromises, but researchers warn the situation will become more urgent very soon.
item.dc:creator: Robert Lemos

item.title: AI Is Ending the Era of Hidden Vulnerabilities — Are Vendors Ready?
item.description: A tidal wave of bug reports is overwhelming software vendors, exposing secure-by-design failures and creating disclosure bottlenecks.
item.dc:creator: Alexander Culafi

item.title: Insurers Search for Answers to Rein in Rogue AI
item.description: As incidents of unintended harm caused by rogue AI agents mount, CISOs and insurance firms are figuring out how to handle the fallout.
item.dc:creator: Robert Lemos

item.title: Large Enterprises Targeted in Fake Merger & Acquisition Scams
item.description: Threat actors behind the "Phantom Deal" campaign are studying companies in extreme detail, aiming to dupe midlevel employees into initiating large financial transfers.
item.dc:creator: Nate Nelson

item.title: What We Missed: Did ShinyHunters 'Breach' ReliaQuest?
item.description: In this video conversation, Dark Reading editors discuss some of the news they didn't get a chance to cover, from the latest antics of ShinyHunters to new research about the prevalence (or lack thereof) of AI-generated malware.
item.dc:creator: Rob Wright, Alexander Culafi

item.title: What the AI Warning Letter Completely Missed
item.description: The recent open letter is right about the "window," but it omits naming who is coming through it or, critically, who will close it.
item.dc:creator: James Lyne

item.title: AI 'Machine Speed' Cuts 2-Week Attack Down to 10 Hours
item.description: The incident demonstrates how frontier AI agents can dramatically compress an attack timeline and coordinate a large-scale breach, according to researchers.
item.dc:creator: Elizabeth Montalbano

item.title: 'Breeze Comet' Tears Into Brazilian & Global Financial Systems
item.description: Brazil's most sophisticated threat group is making light work of the country's financial systems, putting money directly into its own pocket.
item.dc:creator: Nate Nelson

item.title: AI's Vulnerability Surge May Be More Manageable Than First Feared
item.description: New research suggests the coming Vulnpocalypse may not be so overwhelming for enterprise security teams — if they have the right strategies.
item.dc:creator: Jai Vijayan

item.title: SonicWall SMA 1000 Zero-Days Enable Unauthenticated RCE
item.description: The exploitation activity follows attacks earlier this summer on two other zero-day vulnerabilities in the vendor's edge devices.
item.dc:creator: Alexander Culafi

item.title: AI Gives Cybercriminals a Dangerous Time Advantage
item.description: Former cybercriminal Brett Johnson provides a look inside the mind of a threat actor and discusses where AI provides the most value for attackers.
item.dc:creator: Kristina Beek

item.title: Threat Gang 'Springs' Vishing Attacks on Microsoft Teams Users
item.description: The "Spring Ring" operation aims to compromise users of the collaboration suite to remotely access their sessions, spread malware, and even take over infrastructure.
item.dc:creator: Elizabeth Montalbano

item.dc:creator: Jai Vijayan

item.title: Stronger Security Drives Ransomware Groups to Recruit From Within
item.description: Some security researchers have observed an uptick in insider-assisted ransomware attacks, but malicious insiders pose other threats that cost companies millions.
item.dc:creator: Arielle Waldman

item.title: Critical Langflow Vulnerability Exploited as Attacks on AI Platform Rise
item.description: The attacks targeting CVE-2026-0768 are the latest threat against the low-code AI development platform, which is receiving more attention from adversaries this year.

item.title: AI Model Evaluator METR Hit by Credential Theft, Probing

item.title: 'TerminalFix' Campaign Weaponizes PowerShell for Enterprise Attacks
item.description: The ClickFix-style campaign features a sophisticated, multistage attack chain that includes reverse tunnels into victim organizations' networks.

item.title: The Guardrails Debate: Security Researcher Changes His Mind
item.description: While guardrails are critical, as evidenced by recent high-profile incidents, defenders need help staying ahead of attackers who do not play by the rules.

item.description: OpenAI's Hugging Face attack postmortem shows agents don't care about rules — they need strong controls.
item.dc:creator: Jacob Krell
